filename: Generalizable Neural-Network Parameterization of Mesoscale Eddies in Idealized and Global Ocean Models.pdf
title: Generalizable Neural-Network Parameterization of Mesoscale Eddies in Idealized and Global Ocean Models
processes: ocean kinetic and potential energy pathways
testbed_rationale: Provides a public Zenodo archive containing the training data, offline evaluation scripts, trained neural network weights, and MOM6 model configurations for testing scale-aware mesoscale eddy parameterizations.
pain_points: Generalization across unseen grid resolutions, flow regimes, and depth levels due to severe distribution shifts in physical features
Numerical stability when deploying data-driven closures online into coarse dynamical ocean models, requiring clipping/modifications
Compensating model errors: adding a physically improved eddy parameterization can degrade agreement with observations (e.g., AMOC, Drake Passage transport) without comprehensive model retuning
extraction_notes: The paper uses Buckingham's Pi theorem to locally non-dimensionalize input velocity gradients and output subfilter stress tensors by grid spacing and local strain/vorticity scales, enabling zero-shot resolution- and depth-transferability.
